_comment: Single source of truth for the fall equinox promotion. index.html's banner, trail-mix-v2.html's title-screen line and chapter-six tag, and the printable flyer all read this one file (or, on the game side, a constant kept in sync with it by hand) rather than hardcoding the date in three places.
astronomical_equinox_note: Confirmed via WebSearch (NASA/EarthSky/StarWalk, cross-checked 2026-08-17). 23 September 2026 is a Wednesday.
tagline: Equal day. Equal night. Walk the balance point of the year.

cdn_tie_in._comment: This is the real anchor, not a coincidence of timing. See data/cdn-citations.json id=cdn_autumn_equinox_2026 — Ingrid pasted the live page herself, this is human-verified, not search-corroborated.
cdn_tie_in.event_name: CDN Autumn Equinox: Open Research Day
cdn_tie_in.venue: Olav H. Hauge, Litteraturhuset, Østre Skostredet 5, 5017 Bergen
cdn_tie_in.ingrid_panel: The Haunting of the Author, 10:30–11:15, with Yagmur Cisem Vik and Hanna Hellesø Lauvli
cdn_tie_in.note: Ingrid presents at CDN's own event on the astronomical equinox itself, so the Trail Mix walk is deliberately NOT scheduled the same day — she's booked 09:00-15:30. The walk is timed for the following Saturday, framed explicitly as the embodied/public companion to CDN's academic day: CDN talks about digital narrative at Litteraturhuset on the equinox; three days later, Trail Mix walks one.
